article.title: Against sunset laws
article.excerpt: Sunset laws don’t get legislation to be reevaluated anew. The laws simply stay on the books, due to inertia. Here is the full analysis , with many examples of how sunset laws have failed. So if you feel a need to constrain government, look to other tools. Thanks to Chris Mooney for the link and pointer.
